Hi Samir —

Thanks for the interest in walking through Redwood with your engineers. We’d love to run a 60–90 minute technical demo where our SE (Aditya) shows a live inference run, prefix/KV cache behavior, and routing fallbacks; then leave 30 minutes for your engineering team to drill into integration questions.

Quick asks on our side so the session is productive:
- Can you confirm which customer engineers will be on the call (names + emails)? You mentioned Priya; if there are others, please add them.
- We’ll need a short-lived account or token so we can demonstrate a live model against a staging dataset. If you can’t share access, we can screen-share but live runs are much better.
- I’m also looping in our security/compliance contact (Marcus) — Samir, I know you requested SOC 2 evidence. Marcus, can you share the SOC 2 summary and relevant architecture diagram?

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 10, 9:30–11:00
- Tue Aug 10, 14:00–15:30
- Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:30

Please reply with your preferred slot and whether procurement needs a separate 15-min pre-call before the demo (Tina / procurement@cloudnova.io).

Attaching a short runbook and access checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0121

Procurement (Tina) asked me to flag that they’ll want a commercial contact on the invite and the SOC 2 evidence before we schedule anything customer-facing. Can Marcus send a PDF summary and the minimal architecture diagram topologies we typically share? That will speed approvals.

Regarding slots: Tue Aug 10 14:00–15:30 PDT works best for the team. If possible, we’d prefer a short 30-minute deep-dive extension immediately after (15:30–16:00) restricted to our engineers and your SE for integration Q&A. Thanks for the forward — I’m available Tue Aug 10 14:00–16:00 PDT and can run the 60–90 minute demo + 30-minute deep-dive for Priya and friends. Plan:

Agenda (90 + 30):
- 0–10: Quick intros & goals (Chloe/Samir)
- 10–40: Live demo: serving runtime, batching, streaming, failure fallbacks (screen share + live token run)
- 40–60: Architecture deep-dive: routing, KV cache, quantization options (Marcus to cover SOC2/arch notes)
- 60–90: Integration examples, API walkthrough, SDK snippets, token/cost trade-offs
- 90–120 (engineers-only): integration Q&A, auth/token setup, SSO/SSO redirect flow

- Please create a short-lived test token or staging account with a read-only dataset; if you can’t, we’ll do screen-share but integration Q&A will be limited.
- If Priya can drop a short list of sample requests/tests she wants to run, I’ll prepare a tailored snippet.
